technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, the landing page will be a static or server-rendered HTML page with hyperlinks to existing sections (sources, processors, sinks, jobs). No complex backend logic required.

For U2, retry configuration will be implemented by extending the existing RabbitMessageBus retry mechanism with a customizable exception classifier. Configuration properties will be added at the bus and stream deployment levels, allowing users to specify which exception types (fully qualified class names) should be retryable. A special flag will disable retry for Kryo deserialization exceptions by default.
For U3, U4, U5, dependency upgrades will be performed by updating Maven/Gradle dependency versions, resolving any API changes, and running the existing test suite to ensure compatibility.

For U6, module id and container id will be exposed via a static utility method or a bean that can be injected into modules. The ids will be propagated from the runtime environment (e.g., via thread-local or Spring application context properties).

For U7, Kafka bus defaults will be overridable per module by adding new configuration properties (e.g., autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize for consumers; batchSize, batchTimeout for producers) to the consumer and producer factory beans. These properties will be read from the deployment properties of each stream.

For U8, the RPM scripts for XD standalone and XD+Ambari will be consolidated into a single repository. Build scripts will be updated to allow conditional selection of target (standalone vs. Ambari) via a parameter.
assumptions: The development is performed by a single developer who is familiar with the Spring XD codebase.
All existing source code and build infrastructure is available and compilable.
The target Spring XD version is 1.2.0 or later; dependency upgrades are compatible with this version.
The UI for U1 is a simple addition and does not require a full redesign.
U2 does not require changes to the core retry library; only configuration integration.
U6 requires adding a small API change; module developers will use provided utility to access ids.
U7 default values for Kafka properties are already defined; only per-module override logic is needed.
U8 involves merging two separate Git repositories containing RPM build scripts; no major refactoring needed.
All activities include unit testing and documentation as part of the development effort.
An additional integration testing and release activity is included to validate the combined increment.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement a landing page with higher-order links for sources, processors, sinks, and jobs. This includes creating the page template, adding navigation links, and ensuring it integrates with the existing UI framework.

Add configuration properties to allow users to specify which exceptions should be retryable at the bus and stream deployment level. Implement an exception classifier that respects these properties. Also add a flag to disable retry for Kryo deserialization problems. Update documentation and write unit/integration tests.
Update the Spring Integration dependency to version 4.1.5. Resolve any API changes, update imports if necessary, run the full test suite, and fix any failing tests.
Update the Spring Integration Kafka extension dependency to version 1.2.0. Ensure backward compatibility with existing Kafka bus configuration. Run tests and update code as needed.
Update the Spring Hadoop dependency to version 2.2.0 GA. Adjust any configuration or code that uses deprecated APIs. Verify that Hadoop-related components still function correctly.

activities.activity_name: Expose Module ID and Container ID (U6)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a mechanism for module components to obtain the module id and container id at runtime. This may involve adding a utility class or bean that reads environment information. Update the logging framework to include these identifiers by default. Write tests and documentation.

activities.activity_name: Override Kafka Bus Defaults for Module Consumers/Producers (U7)
activities.activity_description: Add configuration properties to allow per-module overrides of Kafka consumer and producer defaults (autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, fetchSize for consumers; batchSize, batchTimeout for producers). Implement the logic to apply these overrides when creating bus instances. Write tests and update documentation.

Merge the XD standalone and XD+Ambari RPM script repositories into a single public repository. Update build scripts to support both targets via a configuration parameter. Ensure that the build process is consistent and documented.
Perform full integration testing of all changes together. Verify that no regressions occur, update release notes, and prepare the final build artifacts.
